🎗️Feedback from Our Lords: October 2026
Updates🎗️
🎗️Thanks for being an awesome part of our
community!
🎗️ Check Out the Full Details Here:
🎗️1. Added Timber, Stone, and Level-based Ruby
Chests to the Guild Stores in the Shadow of the World
Tree and Ember of the Frozen Flame seasons.
🎗️2. Added Dragon Crystal Dust to the Guild Store in
the Tempest of the Tides season.
🎗️3. Lowered the point requirements for the last two
milestones from 21,000 and 30,000 to 18,000 and
26,000, respectively.
🎗️4. Reduced the number of attacks required for
World Boss Quests to 3 during the Cloudsea Odyssey
Season.
🎗️5. After blocking a Lord, you will no longer receive
their help quests in Bounty Quests.
🎗️6. Added shopping cart support to the Guild Honor
Store.
🎗️7. The red dot notifications for Gold Chests and
Silver Chests will disappear after being tapped once
each day after login.
🎗️8. Added a one-tap claim feature for Pet Egg
rewards in the Bounty system.
🎗️9. Optimized PhantomPal Capture in Cloudsea
Odyssey. Lords can now send troops across regions
to capture Pals in their Guild's Ruins Secret Realm.
🎗️10. Added an option to leave Ace Racing mid-race.
Lords can reconnect to the ongoing race by
reopening the event screen.
🎗️11. Increased the claimable fallen soldier
percentage from the Guild Hospital in Fortress Siege
to 40%.
🎗️12. Added an option to choose how much Cheese
to feed Puffel in the Ranch.

🔧 The Artificer's Brain Challenge: Make the Biggest
Number!
Lord, the Artificer has a new brain teaser for you!
⚙️🧠

She’s discovered a clever trick: by moving just one
matchstick, you can turn the number in the image into
an even bigger one!

📅 Event Time: October 27 – November 3

🧩 Challenge Rules
🔍 Move just one matchstick in the image to make
the biggest number possible!
💬 Comment with your Answer + Server Number +
In-Game Name to enter the event!

🎁 Event Rewards
5 lucky Lords will be randomly selected from all valid
entries. Each winner will receive a $4.99 Gold Block
Pack!

💡 The Artificer is ready to see what you come up
with!

Can you find the winning move? Join the challenge
and show off your puzzle-solving skills! ⚙️

Winners! 🎉
Thank you all for joining the event!
Your hero tips, lineup ideas, strategies, and gameplay
advice have helped Eggy learn a lot. Eggy is getting
smarter and will be able to help more new Lords in
the future! ✨
Congratulations to the 16 outstanding Lords who won
rewards!

🔥 Phase 2 Coming Soon! 🔥
Eggy still has more to learn. Phase 2 is already being
prepared, with more mystery rewards waiting for you.
Keep sharing your useful tips and stay tuned to the
official community for the next announcement!
Let’s keep training Eggy together! 💪🐔
